title: Lamb Stew with Italian Flair
description: A hearty Italian-inspired stew made with tender lamb and a blend of flavorful herbs.

ingredients.name: portuguese red wine
ingredients.notes: or substitute with Italian red wine

ingredients.name: herbs
ingredients.notes: dried or fresh basil, thyme, and rosemary

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, chicken broth, herbs, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb stew at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
